input: Arrange a group hiking day for the team

gold.taskTitle: Arrange a Group Hiking Day for the Team
gold.taskDescription: Plan and organise a group hiking day outing for a team, covering logistics, location, and participation details.

questions.title: How many people are joining the hiking day?
questions.description: Understand the group size to plan transportation, permits, and catering accordingly.

questions.title: What is the target date or deadline for this hike?
questions.description: Identify the preferred date or a planning deadline to set a timeline for all arrangements.

questions.title: Is this a work team, friend group, or another kind of team?
questions.description: Clarify the nature of the group to tailor communication style, formality, and activity type.

questions.title: What fitness level should the chosen trail accommodate?
questions.description: Determine whether the route should be beginner-friendly, moderate, or challenging based on the group's ability.

questions.title: Do you have a specific location or region in mind?
questions.description: Find out if there is a preferred hiking area or if suitable locations still need to be researched.

questions.title: What is the approximate budget available per person?
questions.description: Establish financial constraints to guide decisions on transport, food, gear rentals, or guide services.

questions.title: Will food and drinks be arranged, or is it bring-your-own?
questions.description: Clarify catering expectations to determine whether meal planning and procurement are part of the task.
